A tiny animated pet that lives at the bottom of your screen: he walks, naps, eats, dances, and complains when you pick him up.

![Screen Buddy walking, eating, dancing and napping above the taskbar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JulianChaoul16/Screen_Buddy-/main/docs/demo.gif)

## Install (no coding needed)

1. Download **ScreenBuddy.exe** from the Assets below.
2. Double-click it. Your buddy appears at the bottom of your screen, and a small icon appears in the system tray near the clock.
3. Optional: right-click the tray icon and tick **Start with Windows** so he shows up every time you turn on your PC.

To close him, right-click the tray icon and choose **Quit**.

> **"Windows protected your PC"?** That warning appears for apps that aren't code-signed. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## Using him

- **Click** him to pause or resume.
- **Drag** him to carry him around, then let go to watch him fall.
- **Right-click** him or the tray icon to pick an activity.
- **Left-click** the tray icon to hide or show him.
